summary: iter413cx Listing Video Phase 1 verified end-to-end. Backend: all 7 pytest cases in test_iter413cx_listing_video_phase1.py pass — capabilities flipped to enabled (mp4/mov, 100MB, 60s), Compass auto-answers YES from CAPABILITIES, /api/maker/uploads/video accepts a 5s MP4 and rejects non-video MIME / oversized / over-duration via ffprobe, and unauth uploads return 401/403. Frontend: MediaSection 'Product Video' subsection renders with help copy mentioning 60 seconds & 100 MB; editor-video-add empty-state CTA visible; client-side guards fire WITHOUT a network call for both PNG ('Video must be MP4 or MOV.') and >100MB ('Video must be 100 MB or smaller. Yours is 101.0 MB.') — both surfaced via [data-testid=editor-field-error] (no /maker/uploads/video request observed). With a seeded listing_video on a product, the editor renders editor-video-uploaded + editor-video-preview + Replace/Remove buttons and the duration/size badge (10.0s · 1.0 MB); clicking Remove returns to empty state. PDP at /shop/<slug>: product-video-thumb renders with ▶ overlay; clicking it sets active=-2 and renders product-video-player with controls=true, autoplay=false, muted=true, playsInline=true, preload='metadata', poster=cover image. PDP without listing_video correctly omits both thumb and player. Regression: test_iter413cp_batch2.test_video_upload_rejected_for_authed_maker is STALE (still expects 422 video_uploads_disabled, now returns 400 video_unreadable for the fake mp4 bytes) — needs update or deprecation. test_iter413cq_platform_capabilities_and_help has 3 stale assertions that expect upload_enabled=false — need to flip to true.

minor.issue: Stale — expects 422 video_uploads_disabled but the endpoint now accepts/validates (returns 400 video_unreadable on the fake mp4 header). Per the iter413cx note this should be updated or marked deprecated.

Three stale assertions still expect listing_videos.upload_enabled=False and capabilities prompt block to contain '"upload_enabled": false'. With iter413cx flip these now fail. Tests need to be re-baselined to upload_enabled=true / mp4+mov / 60s / 100MB.

action_items: Update or delete /app/backend/tests/test_iter413cp_batch2.py::test_video_upload_rejected_for_authed_maker — the 422 video_uploads_disabled expectation is from before the iter413cx flip.

Re-baseline /app/backend/tests/test_iter413cq_platform_capabilities_and_help.py to assert upload_enabled=true + supported_video_formats=['mp4','mov'] + 60s/100MB caps (currently asserts the OLD 'disabled' shape and fails 3/5).
critical_code_review_comments: MediaSection.jsx — clean: data-testids on every interactive element (editor-video-add, editor-video-input, editor-video-uploaded, editor-video-preview, editor-video-replace, editor-video-remove). Help copy mentions both caps. Empty-state button has proper aspect-video drop-zone styling.

MakerListingEditor.jsx onPickVideo — robust: clears stale value on the input so re-picking the same file works, runs MIME + size guards client-side BEFORE the upload request (verified zero network calls in test), surfaces a distinct 'Processing…' label after upload completes so a 60s clip doesn't look stuck during ffprobe, and posts {url,duration,size,content_type,uploaded_at} into form.listing_video. removeVideo correctly tags _remove_listing_video=true so submit() unsets the field server-side.

ProductDetail.jsx — clean active=-2 sentinel that swaps the hero between <model-viewer>, <video controls>, and the photo zoom button without breaking the existing 3D and lightbox flows. <video> has the spec'd attrs (controls, muted, playsInline, preload='metadata', poster=p.images?.[0], no autoplay). Thumb only renders when p.listing_video?.url is truthy.

PDP autosave note: the editor appears to autosave (banner says 'SAVED JUST NOW'); during testing, clicking Remove on a seeded product persisted remove_listing_video=true a moment later and cleared the field in the DB. This is the intended behavior but worth confirming it's wired to a deliberate user action (Save Draft / Publish) and not a passive timer that could surprise makers — not blocking, just flagging.
test_credentials: Maker JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('iron-and-oak', 'iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org', role='maker'). Stored in localStorage as cm_maker_jwt + cm_maker_slug. Maker portal also accessible via magic-link per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter413cx greenlit. PDP route is /shop/:slug (NOT /products/:slug — the /products path 404s in the SPA even though /api/products/:slug serves the JSON correctly). Editor autosaves — be careful when testing destructive flows like Remove on real products; reseed if needed. The two stale legacy tests (iter413cp_batch2 video-reject + 3 of 5 in iter413cq) are NOT iter413cx bugs, they're follow-up cleanup for the main agent.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature works as specified. Stale legacy tests are an expected consequence of the contract flip and called out as action items.
